name: ISO intermodal container standardization
description: International specifications made compatible container dimensions and associated interchange requirements orderable across transport modes.

places.note: Place is a modern geographic reference to the cited episode; it does not imply exclusive origin.

date.basis: Date stated by the cited source.

events.statement: An ISO freight-container committee participant recalled that by its Moscow meeting the necessary specifications had come together to order an ISO container.
events.caveats: This is a retrospective participant account of standards work, not proof that every operator adopted the specifications.

evidence.supports: An ISO freight-container committee participant recalled that by its Moscow meeting the necessary specifications had come together to order an ISO container.
Interview describes ISO technical committee work.

earliest_record.rationale: The first sourced event for this particular record, not a claim of a worldwide first.

caveats: Several competing national dimensions preceded ISO standardization; interview does not establish the exact date of every ISO document or a worldwide adoption percentage.

research.note: Initial sourced admission; interpretation awaits independent review. Independent review checked event source passages and, where marked, measures and relationship scope; other facets retain prior status.
